title: Apollinarius, Against the Heathen / On Piety / On Truth
english: The work of Apollinarius against the Greeks, on religion, and on truth, has been read by me. The author is a man of Hierapolis, having become bishop of Hierapolis in Asia; he flourished under Marcus Antoninus Verus, emperor of the Romans. The man is notable, and employs a notable style. Other memoirs of his, worth mentioning, are said to exist, which we have not yet come upon.

Codex 14 of 279; Apollinarius of Hierapolis (fl. c. 175), bishop in Lesser Phrygia. Wrote Against the Heathen, On Piety, On Truth under Marcus Aurelius. Style praised by Photius as excellent. Other works lost.
